title: Duplicate follow rows created on follow
description: smallhold creates duplicate rows in the follows table when following a remote account. The follow action inserts two rows with the same persona_id and followee_remote_id. Likely the follow handler runs twice (once on Follow send, once on Accept receive) without checking for existing row. Fix: add UNIQUE constraint or INSERT OR IGNORE.
close_reason: Fixed: root cause was SQLite UNIQUE constraint not enforcing uniqueness when columns are NULL. Added partial unique indexes (WHERE NOT NULL). Migration dedups existing rows.
